intro.text: As your doctor, I have to recommend fewer rooftop fistfights. As your boyfriend, I'm unfortunately impressed.
intro.speaker: Jake

careful.text: Good. Because as a resident, I have no idea when I last slept. Don't make me stitch you up at 3 AM again. The nurses are starting to think you're a hallucination.
careful.speaker: Jake

worth_it.text: Of course it was. You're doing good things out there. Just... try to come home in one piece. I have enough incomplete jigsaw puzzles without adding you to the pile.
worth_it.speaker: Jake

jigsaw.text: I do them in the on-call room. It's either that or stare at the ceiling wondering if I remembered to eat. The 1000-piece ones. I find the edge pieces first. I'm very methodical. You'd know that if you ever stayed in one place long enough to notice.
jigsaw.speaker: Jake

bentley_status.text: Bentley is medically stable. Emotionally, he remains judgmental. He ate all the fish treats again. I caught him trying to open the cabinet with his nose. He's either very smart or very food-motivated. Probably both.
bentley_status.speaker: Jake

more_treats.text: Please do. He's started giving me that look. You know the one. The 'I tolerate you because you have thumbs' look. It's devastating.
more_treats.speaker: Jake

heal_check.text: Let me look at you. Hmm. That's a new bruise. And that's... is that a burn? What are you doing out there? Never mind, I don't want to know. Hold still.
heal_check.speaker: Jake

no_promises.text: I figured. Well, if you're going to get hurt, at least make it stylish. The other residents are starting to take bets on what you'll come in with next. I'm winning, by the way. I had 'falling off a fake palm tree.'
no_promises.speaker: Jake

post_mission.text: You're back. You're walking. These are both good signs. Let me guess — you need stitches, an ice pack, and a lecture about 'acceptable risk thresholds.'
post_mission.speaker: Jake

jake_fine.text: You're never fine. You just have a higher tolerance for 'fine' than medically advisable. Sit down. I'm checking your pupils.
jake_fine.speaker: Jake

jake_stitches.text: Of course you do. Lie down. And try not to bleed on the couch — Bentley already claimed it as his territory and I don't want him getting ideas about hunting you.
jake_stitches.speaker: Jake

many_failures.text: Okay. Okay. Deep breath. You're alive. That's the important thing. The other important thing is that maybe — and I'm just suggesting here — you need a different plan. Because whatever you're doing? It's not working. Three times. Three times you've come back looking like you lost a fight with a ceiling fan.
many_failures.speaker: Jake

jake_figure_out.text: You will. You always do. But maybe talk to Mere first? Or Louis? Someone who knows which end of a plan is the smart end? I love you. I don't want to practice emergency medicine on you anymore.
jake_figure_out.speaker: Jake

jake_close.text: Close only counts in horseshoes and hand grenades. And surgery. Actually, close is terrible in surgery. Please stop being 'close.'
jake_close.speaker: Jake

goodbye.text: Be safe. Or at least be clever.
goodbye.speaker: Jake
